honesty: Physics is an arcade approximation: gravity 9.81 m/s^2; friction, restitution, mass, buoyancy, drag and damage are AUTHORED. Crashes are play - not a crash test, not safety or engineering advice. Vehicles never strike people, NPCs, pets or animals.
units: SI: metres, seconds, kilograms; angles in radians
provenance_rule: world.gravity RECORDED (standard gravity); every other coefficient AUTHORED for play

gravity.note: standard acceleration of gravity 9.80665 m/s^2, used rounded to 9.81

max_substep_frac.note: no sub-step moves more than this fraction of the radius

step_up.note: tallest ledge (curb) walked onto without a jump

air_control.note: share of steering kept while airborne

ground_accel.note: how fast walking speed follows input

land_event_speed.note: falls faster than this emit a land event

wade_min.note: water depth at the feet from which the walker wades

swim_depth.note: water depth at the feet from which the walker swims (= PARISH world.json wade_max_depth_m)

climb_out_m.note: tallest bank above the water surface a wader or swimmer climbs out onto

float_depth.note: a swimmer floats with the feet this far under the surface (head stays above)

float_rate.note: how fast a swimmer eases to the float depth

splash_speed.note: entering water faster than this (down or across) splashes

body_buoyancy.note: upward push on a submerged generic body

water_drag.note: velocity damping in water for bodies

restitution.note: bounce of a generic rigid body

sleep_speed.note: below this at rest a body sleeps

spin_gain.note: scales the yaw spin an off-centre impulse gives

max_spin.note: largest yaw spin a crash leaves (arcade cap)

slide_decay.note: knock-back slide and yaw spin fade

dent_min_ms.note: impacts slower than this leave no dent

dent_per_ms.note: dent added per m/s of impact speed above dent_min_ms

crumple_max.note: largest drawn squash of length at dent 1 (display only)

wheel_step.note: boxes this low or lower are driven over (curbs), taller ones are struck

drop_m.note: ground falling away by more than this under a moving vehicle makes it airborne

tumble_rate.note: pitch/roll rate per m/s of speed when leaving a drop

reset_s.note: a crashed or blocked traffic agent resets after this long

yield_margin.note: extra clearance a vehicle keeps from any person, NPC, pet or animal

smoke_min_ms.note: impacts faster than this puff smoke
